The quotation is about requesting a competition authority (CMA) to review the market structure and competitive conditions in the English early years childcare sector. The specific mechanism is a market investigation/antitrust review of an industry.

Primary dimension: This is fundamentally about industrial organization — market structure review of the childcare services industry, which falls under L4 (Antitrust Issues and Policies) or L8 (Industry Studies: Services). The CMA conducting a market review is quintessentially an antitrust/competition policy action → L4.

Secondary dimension: The subject matter is childcare/early years education, which connects to I2 (Education and Research Institutions) as a substantively important additional dimension.
